ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (amended and restated, Wells Fargo as agent)
ratios.quote: At March 31, 2026, our consolidated total leverage ratio under the Credit Agreement was 4.40 to 1.00 as compared to a covenant maximum of 5.25 to 1.00.

ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (amended and restated, Wells Fargo as agent)
ratios.quote: At March 31, 2026, our consolidated interest coverage ratio under the Credit Agreement was 4.27 to 1.00 as compared to a covenant minimum of 2.75 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: The Third Amendment (Feb 25, 2026) changed the covenants. The maximum leverage ratio steps down from 5.25x in Q1–Q2 2026 to 5.00x in Q3 2026, 4.00x in Q4 2026 and 3.50x from 2027. The minimum interest coverage of 2.75x applies through Q4 2026. The company was in compliance at Dec 31, 2025, but the excerpt gives no ratio values for that date. The same Q1 2026 figures appear again in MD&A. The leverage-based pricing grid is not a covenant and is excluded.
